items.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
items.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

items.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
items.description: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.

items.title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
items.description: There are still hundreds of workers trapped in a network of tunnels that run along the Trishuli river.

items.title: UK support for Falkland Islands 'unwavering' after Argentina restates claims, No 10 says
items.description: The comments come as Argentinian president Javier Milei says the "winds of change" favoured his country's claim on the British overseas territory.

items.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
items.description: The unmanned aerial vehicle struck without warning in the heart of the Ukrainian capital.

items.title: Steve Irwin's family celebrates 'superhero' dad, 20 years after shock death
items.description: The Australian icon was killed in 2006, after a stingray's barb pierced his chest during filming.

items.title: Trump's peace envoys to visit Moscow and Kyiv over weekend
items.description: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have led President Donald Trump's efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war - but talks have stalled.

items.title: Argentine couple to return Nazi-looted painting to rightful owner
items.description: The late-baroque Portrait of a Lady was lost for 80 years until it was spotted in photographs of a house for sale near Buenos Aires.

items.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
items.description: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - the US the only nation to vote against it.

items.title: US diesel prices hit an all-time-high
items.description: Fuel prices have soared since the Iran conflict began at the end of February, mirroring the surge in wholesale oil prices.

items.title: Body of world's youngest traditional king returns home to Uganda amid succession row
items.description: King Oyo died in the US last week aged 34 after receiving treatment for an aggressive form of cancer.

items.title: 100 influencers invited to US Open spark debate on 'tennis etiquette'
items.description: The behaviour of influencers and content creators has become a major talking point at this year's US Open amid incidents of matches being disrupted.

items.title: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
items.description: A man has lived for a record nine months with a transplanted pig kidney while waiting for a human transplant.

items.title: Volkswagen board approves plan to cut another 50,000 jobs
items.description: The group - which includes Audi, Porsche, Skoda as well as the VW brand - plans to cut a total of 100,000 posts by 2030.

items.title: US investigating if missile hit Iran wedding, Vance says
items.description: The Iranian Red Crescent Society (IRCS) said shrapnel from a missile hit the ceremony and killed four people on Tuesday.

items.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
items.description: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.

items.title: Around 2,000 fall ill in Indonesia after eating free school meals
items.description: Authorities are investigating several suspected outbreaks amid growing criticism of the scheme.

items.title: US billionaire Leon Black defies summons and sues Epstein panel
items.description: The lawsuit calls the House Oversight Committee's subpoenas, which ordered him to share nondisclosure agreements, "invalid".

items.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
items.description: Her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City, "surrounded by many who loved her".

items.title: Nepal bet nearly everything on hydropower - the floods show why that's a problem
items.description: More than 10% of Nepal's energy generation capacity was knocked out by last week's floods.
